fieldValues.title: Which acts must stay offices, whatever the confidence?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (7. Against: why affirmation exists), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Ratifying decisions only.
- B. Ratifying, merging owner-merge changes and setting the period's priorities.
- C. Every act on a record the owner wrote.
